newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH CEN.BANK TO HOLD BRIEFING ON RESERVE MOVE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH CEN.BANK TO HOLD BRIEFING ON RESERVE MOVE.

text.p: The deputy president of the National Bank of Poland will meet journalists later on Tuesday to offer more details on the bank's Monday decision to raise obligatory reserves on deposits, the bank's spokeswoman said.
Renata Wisniewska told Reuters that Witold Kozinski would hold a news briefing for selected financial journalists at 1500 local time (1400 GMT).

On Monday the NBP announced it was increasing as of February 28 mandatory reserves on zloty call deposits by three points to 20 percent and on currency deposits by two points to four percent. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
